hypothesis: Fixed O1/O2 causal CCA retains offline four-target accuracy on untouched subjects, and the identical stateful implementation can run as isolated ARM replay.
initialization: Subtract first raw sample, zero SOS state; retain state and buffers between batches. Reset state, result and buffer at explicit disconnect, sample-index discontinuity or nonfinite selected input.
trial_handling: Wang epochs are target-sorted rather than continuous chronological EEG. Reset every epoch; 160-sample pre-window warmup includes 125 pre-stimulus samples and 35 post-onset samples. Never join epochs into a purported real continuous recording.
primary_endpoint: First complete window, samples [160,660), four-class accuracy averaged by participant; 24 trials/person.
baselines: same offline signal scored by portable core
causal 6-45Hz only scored by portable core
primary_candidate: causal 50Hz notch Q30 then 6-45Hz bandpass, portable CCA; no SQI or confidence threshold selected on heldout data
preregistered_gate: Candidate participant mean accuracy >= 0.70 AND paired bootstrap 95% lower bound versus previous offline baseline >= -0.05. Otherwise do not proceed to board replay in this run; do not tune using this heldout set.
scope: Candidate frequencies only; actual control always disabled. No idle/non-target class exists in this benchmark, so false-activation rate and rejection thresholds remain unvalidated. ARM replay is not live acquisition or PL acceleration.
